Package org.geysermc.paletter.creative

Class CreativeContent

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.creative.CreativeContent
public final class CreativeContent extends Object
A CreativeLayout compiled for one palette: what is sent in the CreativeContentPacket.

Compilation takes care of every protocol rule, so layouts never need to:

  • categories are emitted in client order, and groups never leave their category;
  • each run of loose stacks becomes an unnamed group with an air icon;
  • stacks whose item does not exist in this version are dropped, and groups left empty are dropped too (the client crashes on empty groups);
  • a group without an icon, or whose icon does not exist in this version, uses its first stack;
  • network ids are assigned sequentially from 1, so entry(int) is an array lookup.
Since:
1.0.0
